previous.description: Command-line companion for Kronikol. Includes `kronikol merge`, which combines several mergeable TestRunReport.json files (produced with GenerateMergeableData enabled — e.g. by parallel CI runners) into a single combined TestRunReport.html; `kronikol ingest`, which replays language-neutral NDJSON interaction captures (from an out-of-process proxy tap or any non-.NET capturer) into a full Kronikol report; `kronikol query`, which answers questions about a TestRunReport.json — why a test failed, what a service returned, where a wrong value came from — without loading the file, so a 10 MB report is debuggable by tooling and by AI agents; and `kronikol export`, which pushes NDJSON interaction captures to an OTLP/HTTP collector as OpenTelemetry spans so the traffic only Kronikol saw appears in Tempo/Jaeger next to the app's real traces.

previous.description: A caching reverse proxy for the Git LFS HTTP API. The zero command line tool. Materializes the rule files that ship inside the Zero packages into AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and editor rule files, so coding agents work from the same rules the compiler enforces.

MCP (Model Context Protocol) server exposing Kookerella.FsWordDsl's Word document capabilities as tools any MCP-compatible AI agent can call directly: build a document, read one back, decompile an existing one into idiomatic F# or C# source, or translate to/from plain XML or JSON, each against a real schema. The XML/JSON directions each have two uses beyond code generation: build a .docx directly from XML/JSON a transform engine (e.g. XSLT) or generation script already produces, no code required; or convert an existing .docx to XML/JSON for text-based diffing and version control in systems like git. The same conversions are available as plain CLI commands (fsworddsl-mcp convert/build) for anyone not going through an MCP client.

A .NET command-line tool for batch-normalizing icon images into a consistent set. Recolours each image to a single-colour silhouette, trims transparent margins, centres the artwork on a square canvas, and resizes it to a maximum dimension with optional padding. Built on ImageSharp with no native dependencies, making it a fast way to unify icon packs collected from different sources.
